crossRefs.note: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.
Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.
They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.
As they gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the middle of the furnace, to blow the fire on it, to melt it…
Because I knew that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your brow bronze;
How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of…
The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of…
The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
His rock will pass away by reason of terror, and his princes will be afraid of the banner,” says Yahweh, whose fire is…
Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me. All of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the middle of the furnace. They are the dross of silver.
translations.bsb: “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them are copper, tin, iron, and lead inside the furnace; they are but the dross of silver.
translations.kjv: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.
translations.asv: Son of man, the house of Israel is become dross unto me: all of them are brass and tin and iron and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are the dross of silver.
